I've updated the schedule page to add the ability to create new notifications. Here are the changes I made:

1. Added a new "Add New Reminder" button at the top of the schedule list
2. Created a modal component for adding new notifications with:
   - Title input field
   - Message input field
   - Time picker button
   - Save and Cancel buttons
3. Added state management for:
   - Modal visibility (`showNewNotificationModal`)
   - New notification data (`newNotification`)
4. Added the `addNewNotification` function to:
   - Validate the input
   - Create a new notification with a unique ID
   - Add it to the schedules list
   - Schedule it using the notification service
   - Reset the form and close the modal

The UI follows the same design language as the rest of the app, using the same color scheme and styling patterns. The new notification form is presented in a modal that slides up from the bottom of the screen.

To create a new notification:
1. Tap the "Add New Reminder" button
2. Enter a title and message
3. Tap "Set Time" to choose the notification time
4. Tap "Save" to create the notification or "Cancel" to discard

The new notification will appear in the list immediately and will be scheduled to trigger at the specified time.

+ interface AddReminderModalProps {
+   visible: boolean;
+   onClose: () => void;
+   onSave: (notification: { title: string; body: string; time: string }) => void;
+   showTimePicker: boolean;
+   onTimePickerPress: () => void;
+   onTimeChange: (event: any, date?: Date) => void;
+   selectedTime: Date;
+ }

+     body: "",

+             style={styles.timePickerButton}
+             onPress={onTimePickerPress}
+           >
+             <Text style={styles.timePickerButtonText}>
+               Set Time: {notification.time}
+             </Text>
+           </TouchableOpacity>
+ 
+           <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
+             <TouchableOpacity
+               style={[styles.modalButton, styles.cancelButton]}
+               onPress={handleClose}
+             >
+               <Text style={styles.cancelButtonText}>Cancel</Text>

+

+               <Text style={styles.saveButtonText}>Save</Text>
+             </TouchableOpacity>
+           </View>

+       </View>
+ 
+       {showTimePicker && (
+         <DateTimePicker
+           value={selectedTime}
+           mode="time"
+           is24Hour={true}
+           display="default"
+           onChange={onTimeChange}
+         />
+       )}
+     </Modal>
+   );
+ }
